scripts.build:core: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:code-index && pnpm --filter @codemap-ai/core run build
scripts.build:mcp: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @codemap-ai/mcp run build
scripts.build:cli: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @codemap-ai/cli run build
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @codemap-ai/shared --filter @codemap-ai/code-index --filter @codemap-ai/core --filter @codemap-ai/tool-types --filter @codemap-ai/mcp --filter @codemap-ai/cli version patch --no-git-tag-version --no-git-checks
scripts.release:patch: pnpm run version:patch && git add package.json packages/*/package.json pnpm-lock.yaml && node scripts/release.mjs
